Entrata + KH Equities | Demo and Discussion
callsUsed.brief: Justin and Rolanda from Entrata, along with Daniel from KH Equities, discussed Entrata's comprehensive property management platform, focusing on its automation capabilities for marketing, lead-to-lease processes, and maintenance workflows, while addressing Daniel's concerns about data accuracy and integration with third-party managed properties. Daniel expressed interest in the platform's efficiency gains and requested a pricing sheet to evaluate its cost-effectiveness for KH Equities' portfolio. The call concluded with a plan for a follow-up pricing discussion and potential future demos for specific functionalities like affordable housing.

callsUsed.title: Entrata - KH Equities: Pricing
callsUsed.brief: Justin from Entrata, along with Daniel from KH Equities, discussed Entrata's comprehensive core bundle pricing of $6.15 per unit, which includes property management, accounting, and various resident-facing tools, emphasizing its all-inclusive nature compared to tiered competitors. They also explored optional products like utility management, AI, and a Digital Marketing Bundle, alongside ancillary revenue opportunities from renters' insurance and deposit alternatives, which can offset software costs. Daniel, while finding the pricing "a bit rich" compared to current solutions, agreed to a follow-up meeting to further evaluate Entrata's offerings with his team.
